testcase.name: Discontinuities: a cosmetic gap jumps forward by design; pause/resume or seek removes it; a reset tick counter is rejected for control (section 6.5)
Low TPS: GAME time follows ticks (half speed at 10 TPS), COSMETIC time follows supplied nanoseconds (real-time speed) (sections 3, 6.2)
Reversal: a negative rate runs a timing backwards through its start into BEFORE (sections 4, 5)
Integer pause/resume chains are exact: local time equals the playing span, after 100,000 control events (section 6.3)
Determinism: equal inputs give bit-identical outputs, across repeated calls and freshly built equal objects (section 6.1)
Path independence: skipped, irregular or out-of-order evaluation gives exactly the values of regular evaluation (section 6.2)
Long-running: 10 million consecutive ticks from 2^40 are exact integers with exact loop phases, no drift (section 6.4)
Fractional rate chains: the error after n re-anchorings is at most 2 n 2^-52 max|local| against exact arithmetic (section 6.4)
